facts.title: unplanned release of gravity energy at HO-9403

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work on HO-9403 and M-9403 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on HO-9403 and M-9403 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically preparing and approving a lift study. HO-9403 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during routine operation while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 19 December 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on HO-9403 and M-9403 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
